notes: Engineering task (L1 the dashboard tells the truth, tersely), no epistemic register change. Two operator rulings 2026-08-23 implemented in untracked/watch-fleet.sh, docs/infra/model-registry.md and tools/regression-watch-fleet.sh. RULING 1 (short model names on every human surface, rendered through ONE table): the hardcoded mdl() case statement is replaced by an awk lookup against the 'Short names → canonical' table in docs/infra/model-registry.md — watch-fleet holds no second mapping. A worker's argv can carry the short name (--dsflash startup alias), a canonical label (--model deepseek-v4-flash), a serving tag (--model glm-5.2:cloud, stealth/ox-alpha) or a prefix (qwen3.8); a model string matches a row when it equals, prefixes, or is prefixed by the row's short/canonical/serving-tag cell, and unknown models fall back to the pre-colon prefix (a rendering fallback, not a map). Two mdl() authoring defects were caught during the red run: awk's exit still runs the END block, so the fallback printed after a match (fixed with a found flag), and an empty model string matched every row via index(s,'')==1 (fixed with an m != '' guard). The registry itself was updated per the ruling: the flash short name renamed flash -> dsflash and an oxalpha row added (| `oxalpha` | `oxalpha` | `stealth/ox-alpha` |); prose and the table header annotation updated to note the T739 ruling. Result: flash renders dsflash, stealth/ox-alpha renders oxalpha, and no canonical label or serving tag can reach the model column (arm J asserts the column is hyphen/colon/slash-free). RULING 2 (fill the screen): the layout reserve was 2k+6 — the pre-T738 constant that still banked the banner's 3 lines — so a data-rich frame left blank rows while DONE/OPEN had rows left to show. Replaced with exact accounting: k headings + (k-1) separators + 2-line footer + 1 spare (footer never scrolls off) + 1 '(more)' per flexible section whose rows exceed its MIN_ROWS floor; avail is floored at 0. Every line recovered becomes a visible row: arm K pins a 40-row terminal with 20 DONE + 20 OPEN at 16+16 rows shown / 37-line one-shot frame (old: 15+15 / 35); the interactive frame adds the 2-line footer = 39 <= 40 with the spare. COMMITTING uncovered a fresh shared-tooling breakage, fixed test-first and recorded here. tools/git-commit-mine's staging `git add -- <abs paths>` returns rc=1 on Apple Git 2.50.1 whenever a pathspec lies under an ignored directory — even for a TRACKED file it stages correctly. untracked/watch-fleet.sh is tracked but lives under the gitignored untracked/ dir, so the wrapper refused every commit naming it ("a named path is missing or ignored"). Reproduced in a scratch repo: plain add rc=1 (and the file still staged), add -f rc=0, genuinely-missing path rc=128. No commit touched untracked/ between T547 (17:36, the wrapper's current staging form) and T739, so the breakage went unexercised; T738 committed the same file at 12:32 with the identical wrapper, before the git behavior bit. Fix: arm 15 added to tools/regression-git-commit-mine.sh — a tracked file under an ignored dir must stage and commit (RED with the plain add, GREEN with -f) — and the wrapper's staging changed to `git add -f --`, with the rationale in a comment (the wrapper only ever adds explicitly named paths; the scope/holds checks still apply; a missing path still fails with rc 128, so the typo guard is intact; the one behavior change — a named, genuinely-ignored NEW file is staged instead of refused — does not touch the wrapper's four guarantees, all ignore-rule-independent). The wrapper fix is a separate commit under --explicit (6179315; shared tooling outside T739's scope — the loud escape, documented here); regression-git-commit-mine-hook and regression-commit-concurrency re-ran clean. The T739 bundle header's deliverables= was corrected to the true commit paths (untracked/watch-fleet.sh, tools/regression-watch-fleet.sh, docs/infra/model-registry.md + the findings file) when the scope gate refused — exactly the T738 precedent recorded in its own notes.
